title: Getting Started with Cobalt Blue Business Checking
summary: This document explains how to set up and use Cobalt Blue Business Checking: fund the account, enroll in online/mobile banking, set balance and activity alerts, and add authorized users. It lists a $20 monthly maintenance fee (waived with $2,500+ daily balance), 0.5% APY interest, $175 free transactions/month, referral earnings ($150 per successful referral; $100 welcome bonus to referred businesses) capped at 10/year, plus a first-week checklist.
faqs: How do I waive the $20 monthly maintenance fee for Cobalt Blue Business Checking?
How can I enroll in online and mobile banking and set up account alerts?
When does interest start accruing, and what APY will I earn on available balance?
What counts toward the $175 free transactions per month, and what happens after I exceed it?
How do Cobalt Blue business referrals work (payout amounts and the 10 referrals/year limit)?
What should I complete in the first week to ensure the account is ready and fee/interest requirements are met?
